document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
The  deaths  of  your  companions  recur  vividly  in  your 
imagination.  Not  caring  whether  or  not  the  torrent  carries 
you off, you dash through the fissure and out of the valley of 
prehistoric survivals, alone.
